measure: saw or heard an ad of this type that led them to take action in the past 30 days

rows: Streaming TV advertising (such as Hulu, Pluto TV or YouTube TV)
Mobile phone app or text message
Ad on search results pages (like on Google, Yahoo or Bing)
Television (traditional, including cable or satellite subscription)
Online display ads (banners and pop-up ads)
Ad that plays before or during the video you want to watch
Text link ad on a website
Advertising circulars in your mailbox or inserted in the newspaper
Magazine (print, online, mobile or on tablet)
